notes.title: Tobii EyeX Integration...

We just pushed an update that includes Tobii EyeX camera support.  If you have one of these really cool cameras you can now look at the edges of your cockpit to move camera based on your gaze (similar to TrackIR).

You can also quickly target ships using the EyeX key and your eyes.  

It's a really cool way to interact with the game using your eyes!

- BPG

notes.title: Steam Workshop and Custom Missions Added!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

We are extremely excited to announce that Steam Workshop and Custom Mission support has been patched into the game with today's major update.

What does this mean?  

You now can create and share with the community custom missions using the same exact tools we used when creating the singleplayer game!

We've created a wiki and multiple tutorial videos that cover the basics of creating and uploading a mission and you can find this information on the Steam Workshop page.  Please note the wiki is still very much a work-in-progress and will be updated in the days and weeks to come.  

We look forward to playing what the community creates!

- Bit Planet Games Team

notes.title: 5/15/2015 Update!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

We just posted a fairly sizable update that includes a variety of improvements and enhancements.

Here are the build notes:

- Increased size of targeting reticle when using a gamepad. This has made gameplay with a gamepad much better.

- The Hades space-fighter now has two different missile types based on whether you fired a homing or dummy missile. The homing missile moves significantly slower, lasts longer, but has a higher damage output. The dummy missile moves much faster, has a short lifetime, but has a weak damage output. 

- We completely revamped the Pluto environments due to an environment crash we were getting when running the game on NVIDIA's upcoming Shield console. We drastically simplified the space station while, I think, making it look cooler. 

- We cut the ETS transfer energy between systems due to it being a rather superfluous feature. Players tended to just use the ETS regen system to manage their energy systems. We also changed how players interacted with ETS regen. The first training mission has been adjusted to account for these changes. 

- Tons of bug fixes, mission tweaks, and game balancing.

Unfortunately, we weren't able to get to Achievements due to our focus on the bugs and the Android build. We expect to get them done within the next two weeks though.

Chris

notes.title: February Update!
notes.content:
Hey guys,

We humbly apologize for being so late with this update. However, we do think it was well worth the wait as we march towards full release.

The amount of new stuff in this update (compared to the last one) is staggering.

Nearly, all the missions (except for the last two) are now in the game. We've finished writing and VO recording and that's also been implemented! We finished the cockpit visuals for the COD Fighter along with all new HUD for both ships. We put in a new COD Carrier ship and it's massive! In fact, its the largest ship in the game by a fairly wide margin. Fleet mode has been overhauled again - you can now choose from multiple Fleet Commanders at the start, upgrade your fleet as you progress, and so much more. It's almost an entire game in and of itself (we're still not done with this mode though). There have been a tremendous amount of bug fixes, game optimizations, balancing tweaks, AI improvements, VFX work, and the list goes on and on.

We know there are still bugs though so if you guys find any don't hesitate to post on these forums. Look for probably two updates per week starting next week until we take it out of greenlight. 

In future updates, look for completely redesigned sound FX, improved visual FX, the final two missions, achievements, and maybe even Steam Trading Cards.

We're almost to the finish line!

Thank you everyone for being so patient. If you guys like what you see and play please don't hesitate to tweet and/or tell your friends about TBoS. 

Chris

notes.title: 11/3/2014 Update...
notes.content:
Wow, this past month has been a bit of a whirlwind.

As you can probably see by now we're rebranding the game to "The Battle of Sol".  This slight name change was done to further separate us from the original game.  Why?

A couple of reasons but the primary one is that people were getting confused between the two.  Hopefully, as word spreads this will slowly change.  

So what's new in this update?

- Missions 3 and 6 have been completely overhauled.
- UCS Capital Ships are larger.
- Lots of balancing and bug-fixes.
- Fleet mode has been completely overhauled.  Players now truly command a fleet a ships as you jump from sector-to-sector in search of fuel and salvage.  We've incorporated a 3rd person (ship?) camera and you can now issue orders to your various ships to attack, launch fighters, repair, etc.  Our goal for Fleet mode is to offer a very different, more systemic experience from the main campaign.  Please check it out and offer as much feedback as you can.  The mode still needs a fair bit of work but what's there should be enough to get a good sense of what we're aiming for.


As always please use the forums to let us know of any issues you run into and, of course, feedback everything that has changed!

Bit Planet Games

notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We just pushed a fairly large update to the game.  Here are the notes:

- Missions 06 and 07 have been added.  These are still in what I would consider an Alpha state so please let us know if you find any bugs.

Thanks!

notes.title: Part 1 of September 2014 massive update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone...

Today we're releasing part 1 of this month's massive update.  

Build notes:

Major Features

- Based on feedback we've changed Slide to what we're now calling Strafe and, furthermore, made it a toggle.  When Strafe is activated throttle is turned off but you now can use manual thrusters to move left, right, up and down.  We want your feedback on this new system!

- 2 new missions!  Our missions now feature persistent ship system (meaning health and even which ships lived or died is kept track of - and may or may not appear in future missions!).  Also, some missions now feature multiple maps!

- New pilot-able ship!  We're adding missions that have you playing for our antagonists, the Children of Dawn!  These set of missions actually are tightly integrated into the main story and allows everyone to get to know the enemy faction a little bit better.  Players pilot the COD Fighter.  We're still working on the cockpit and HUD UI so this stuff is very much WIP.  However, the ship's handling and weapon systems are very different from the UCS ship you were piloting.

- Lots of misc. balance stuff.  Most every mission has been heavily tweaked (and this will continue during EA).

- New Orders system!  This system doesn't become available until Mission 03 but when it does you'll be able to give orders to your Wingman!  

- So many bugs and/or polish stuff!  

We'll probably do a couple of more minor updates between now and when we release Part 2 of this month's massive update - the open world module!

As always feedback is definitely needed and welcomed with open arms!

Chris

- 2 new missions!  Our missions now feature persistent ship system (meaning health and even which ships lived or died is kept track of - and may or may not appear in future missions!).  Also, some missions now feature multiple maps!

- New pilot-able ship!  We're adding missions that have you playing for our antagonists, the Children of Dawn!  These set of missions actually are tightly integrated into the main story and allows everyone to get to know the enemy faction a little bit better.  Players pilot the COD Fighter.  We're still working on the cockpit and HUD UI so this stuff is very much WIP.  However, the ship's handling and weapon systems are very different from the UCS ship you were piloting.

- Lots of misc. balance stuff.  Most every mission has been heavily tweaked (and this will continue during EA).

- New Orders system!  This system doesn't become available until Mission 03 but when it does you'll be able to give orders to your Wingman!  

- So many bugs and/or polish stuff!  

We'll probably do a couple of more minor updates between now and when we release Part 2 of this month's massive update - the open world module!

As always feedback is definitely needed and welcomed with open arms!

Chris

notes.title: Game Update 8/6/14
notes.content:
We released another update today!

- Hades missiles now have two firing modes.  Press the missile button to launch a dummy missile (non-homing).  Hold down the missile button to lock-on to a target, release to fire.  The main difference between these modes is the missile moves considerably slower when locked-on to a target.

- The second and fouth missions have had mulitple improvements to them (in fact, there is a somewhat secret quick way of completing the fourth mission - see if you can find it!).

- We added an auto-targeting system so that if you don't have an active target selected and you start firing at one the game will make that ship or object your current target.  We think this system will improve usability for new players.

- Various bug-fixes.

As always, please use the forums for posting bugs and/or feedback!

Thanks,

BPG
